facts.fact: Leadpages reports that the average landing page conversion rate is 6.6% across industries, and that top performers reach 10% or higher.
facts.quote: The average landing page conversion rate is 6.6% across industries, and top performers reach 10% or higher

facts.fact: Leadpages says top-performing landing pages reach a conversion rate of 10% or higher.
facts.quote: top performers reach 10% or higher when they keep the page tightly focused on one goal

facts.fact: ZoomInfo's analysis of more than 18,000 landing pages found that pages with a single primary CTA or link reached an average conversion rate of 13.5%.
facts.quote: An analysis of more than 18,000 landing pages found that pages with a single primary CTA or link reached an average conversion rate of 13.5%

facts.fact: In ZoomInfo's analysis, landing pages with 2 to 4 links averaged an 11.9% conversion rate.
facts.quote: compared with 11.9% for pages with 2 to 4 links and 10.5% for pages with 5 or more

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance is that a landing page is probably clear enough if a visitor can view the hero for 10 to 15 seconds and accurately describe the offer, audience, and next action.
facts.quote: If a customer can look at the hero for 10 to 15 seconds and accurately describe the offer, the audience, and the next action

facts.fact: More than half of landing page visits now happen on phones, according to the author.
facts.quote: More than half of landing page visits now happen on phones.

facts.fact: The author says a 30 to 60 second explainer video is often enough to show the workflow for SMB offers that introduce a less familiar channel like TV advertising.
facts.quote: A 30 to 60 second video is often enough to show the workflow, explain who the service is for, and set expectations

facts.fact: The author recommends a first-touch landing page form that asks only for name, email, and phone (if follow-up calls are part of the sales process), plus at most one qualifier that changes routing or eligibility.
facts.value: 3 core fields plus up to 1 qualifier
facts.quote: Ask only for the information required to move the lead to the next stage.

facts.fact: The author describes a cleanest copy structure of pain, promise, proof, action for landing page copy.
facts.quote: The cleanest copy structure is pain, promise, proof, action.

facts.fact: The author recommends a single-column form layout, labels outside the fields, and button copy matched to the action rather than a generic 'Submit'.
The article states that for most SMB landing pages, three to five process steps is enough, and more than that starts to feel like onboarding before the conversion.
facts.quote: For most SMB pages, three to five steps is enough. More than that starts to feel like onboarding before the conversion.

facts.fact: The article presents Adwave's workflow as four steps: enter your website URL, review the AI-generated ad, choose targeting, and launch the campaign.
The article's landing page guide covers ten best practices, which the reader is advised to review against a live page.
facts.quote: review it against these ten best practices
